failure: Failure: Existence of suitable corrections, admissibility of the linear residual, and a compatible o(n)-enlargement that removes the debt are unproved. The source explicitly says this is not a superlinear total-error bound and supplies no flexible-stability conclusion.
interface: Interface: Corrections b_s are supplied, skew-adjoint, and small in normalized Hilbert-Schmidt norm; the linearized residual E is also supplied through the assumption ||E||<=eta. The word length L, number of generators |S|, and cutoffs tau,sigma are explicit. This is not an algorithm for finding b_s.

claims.title: A supplied full-unitary correction admits a diffuse-plus-rank-debt decomposition
